Name: Dacar Style for Sushi Project Portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
I know I said ESR was next, I just was asked this and since it was quick I just had to.

Portraits for The Sushi Project in my Style! This may not work with Bigger Backpacks so beware of that!


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]

Next mod will be:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]ESR[/url]  and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]East Scarp Seasonals[/url] (I need to finish the new NPCs and clothes)

After that I will be making one of this mods if I get the okay, pretty much in this order:

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the valley[/url]
